signal_notation: R-VS52 / SWC 0708（Send CAN: MSG.Sig = raw (label)；ER … is sent）

tcs.tc_title: Stop-start enabled and engine stopped -> seat and steering wheel indicators off
tcs.test_item:
If the stop-start system is enabled the HMI shall turn off the heated/vented seats and the heated steering wheel switch indicators based on the $EngRun_Stat$ signal and the $ESS_ENG_ST$ signal.

(Stop-start enabled, engine stopped)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 2 (Engine_On)
3. Activate the heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switches on the Climate screen
4. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 1 (ENS Stopped)
5. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 0 (Engine_Off) and check that the heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switch indicators are turned off
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running) is sent
2. STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 2 (Engine_On) is sent
3. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switch indicators are lit
4. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 1 (ENS Stopped) is sent
5. The heated seat, vented seat and heated steering wheel switch indicators are turned off

tcs.tc_title: ESS_ENG_ST monitored to attribute engine-state change to stop mode
tcs.test_item:
If the stop-start system is enabled the HMI shall monitor the $ESS_ENG_ST$ signal to determine if a change in $EngRun_Stat$ is a result of the vehicle entering stop mode.

(Engine-off attributed to stop mode, not to key-off)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 2 (Engine_On)
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 4 (ENS Stop Pending)
4. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 0 (Engine_Off)
5. Read the signal STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST and check that it is 1 (ENS Stopped)
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running) is sent
2. STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 2 (Engine_On) is sent
3. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 4 (ENS Stop Pending) is sent
4. STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 0 (Engine_Off) is sent
5. The signal STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST reads 1 (ENS Stopped) while the signal STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts reads 0 (Engine_Off)

tcs.tc_title: Stop mode with stop-start not disabled -> heat and vent switches stay active
tcs.test_item:
If ($EngRun_Stat$ <> [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN] && $ESS_ENG_ST$ <> [ENS_DSBL] && $ESS_ENG_ST$ <> [SNA])then the HMI shall continue to activate all heat and vent switches currently active and allow the customer to select the switches.

(Stop mode, stop-start neither disabled nor SNA)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat and vented seat switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Activate all heat and vent switches on the Climate screen
3. PENDING: DR-19 EngRun_Stat 之規格值 IDLE_STBL / UNLIMITED / LIMITED / RUN 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應，無法決定滿足不等條件之匯流排值
4. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 1 (ENS Stopped) and check that all heat and vent switches remain active and selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running) is sent
2. All heat and vent switches are lit
3. PENDING: DR-19
4. All heat and vent switches remain lit and respond to selection

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之 ESS_ENG_ST 非 ENS disabled 亦非 SNA，故 heat and vent switches stay active；-005 之 ESS_ENG_ST = ENS disabled，故 greyed out。

tcs.tc_title: Stop mode with stop-start disabled -> heat and vent switches greyed out
tcs.test_item:
If ($EngRun_Stat$ <> [IDLE_STBL//UNLIMITED//LIMITED//RUN] && $ESS_ENG_ST$ = [ENS_DSBL])then The HMI shall grey-out all heat and vent switches.

(Stop mode with stop-start disabled)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Stop-Start system
2. The heated seat and vented seat switches are shown on the Climate screen
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running)
2. PENDING: DR-19 EngRun_Stat 之規格值 IDLE_STBL / UNLIMITED / LIMITED / RUN 於 LID 與 DBC 皆無對應，無法決定滿足不等條件之匯流排值
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 7 (ENS disabled) and check that all heat and vent switches are greyed out
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running) is sent
2. PENDING: DR-19
3. All heat and vent switches are greyed out

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之 ESS_ENG_ST = ENS disabled，故 heat and vent switches greyed out；-004 之 ESS_ENG_ST 為其他值，故 stay active。

tcs.tc_title: ESS_ENG_ST = SNA -> stop-start restrictions not applied
tcs.test_item:
IF ($ESS_ENG_ST$ = [SNA])then The HMI shall behave as if the vehicle is not equipped with the Stop-Start system.

(Stop-start status signal not available)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The heated seat and vented seat switches are shown on the Climate screen
2. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 2 (Engine_On)
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 15 (SNA)
4. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 0 (Engine_Off) and check that all heat and vent switches remain selectable and are not greyed out
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 3 (ENS Running) is sent
2. STATUS_CCAN3.EngineSts = 2 (Engine_On) is sent
3. STATUS_CCAN3.ESS_ENG_ST = 15 (SNA) is sent
4. All heat and vent switches remain selectable and are not greyed out

tcs.tc_title: Driver side setting does not change unlabelled seat switch request
tcs.test_item:
If there is no Driver or Passenger label for Heated and Vented seats, the $DriverSide$ signal value shall have no impact on the Heated and Vented seat switch behavior.

(Right-hand drive, no Driver or Passenger label)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The heated and vented seat switches carry no Driver or Passenger label
2. The Climate screen is reachable from the Menu Bar
3. BH-CAN is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Set PROXI Driver_Side = 0 (Left Side) and power cycle the HU
2. Press the left front heated seat switch, read TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm and record as FL_HS_Tlm_LHD
3. Set PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side) and power cycle the HU
4. Press the left front heated seat switch, read TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.FL_HS_Tlm and record as FL_HS_Tlm_RHD
5. Check that FL_HS_Tlm_RHD equals FL_HS_Tlm_LHD
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up with PROXI Driver_Side = 0 (Left Side)
2. FL_HS_Tlm_LHD is recorded as 1 (Pressed)
3. The HU completes start-up with PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
4. FL_HS_Tlm_RHD is recorded as 1 (Pressed)
5. FL_HS_Tlm_RHD = FL_HS_Tlm_LHD

tcs.tc_title: Right-hand drive with side labels -> driver and passenger labels swapped
tcs.test_item:
If there are Driver and Passenger labels for Heated and Vented seats, when $DriverSide$ = [Right Drive] the HMI shall: switch the labels of the driver and passenger heated/vented seats buttons.

(Right-hand drive with Driver and Passenger labels)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The heated and vented seat switches carry Driver and Passenger labels
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 0 (Left Side)
3. The Climate screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the labels of the heated and vented seat buttons and record the button carrying "Driver" as Driver_label_initial
2. Set PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side)
3. Power cycle the HU so that the configuration is applied
4. Read the labels of the heated and vented seat buttons and check that the "Driver" and "Passenger" labels have swapped sides compared with Driver_label_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. Driver_label_initial is recorded
2. PROXI Driver_Side = 1 (Right Side) is accepted
3. The HU completes start-up and the Climate screen is displayed
4. The "Driver" label is on the opposite heated and vented seat button from Driver_label_initial

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Dump button lowers both third row head restraints together
tcs.test_item:
When the Headrest Dump Softkey button is pressed, the HMI shall simultaneously activate both left and right third-row head restraint dump functions. The left and right head restraint dump functions shall operate together and shall not be independently controlled.

(Single press, both restraints lower together)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Both third row head restraints are in the raised position
2. The Headrest Dump Softkey button is shown and selectable
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the position of the left and right third row head restraints and check that both are raised
2. Press the "Headrest Dump" softkey button and check that both the left and the right third row head restraints lower
tcs.expected_result:
1. Both third row head restraints read raised
2. The left and the right third row head restraints lower at the same time

reasoning: 本批為 batch01_v2 依 pilot review 第二輪（38 包 §1）之缺陷修正，v1／v2 皆保留。驗證目標未變。`SwitchLHD/RHD-009` 依 D-1 改為 §5.6 之 baseline 比較 —— 其需求主張的是「$DriverSide$ 改變時行為不變」之一個比較，原寫法只證明右駕下按鍵會送出請求，即使 $DriverSide$ 有影響仍會通過，屬 §7 之 false pass。`Stop-Start-004`／`-005` 依 D-2 將驗證併入最後一個可執行步驟，使末步驟含 action ＋ check。`Stop-Start-006`（DR-19）與 `SwitchLHD/RHD-010`（DR-20）依 D-3 自本批移出 —— 二者扣除 PENDING 行後之可執行步驟不足 2，另存 `blocked_pending_dr.json`，待該二 DR 覆後再入批。批次規模由 10 降為 8。
